questions.question: Show that 25 times 16 equals 16 times 25 using chairs in a hall, and name the property.
questions.expected_answer: 25 rows of 16 chairs and 16 rows of 25 chairs are the same rectangle seen from two sides, so both have 400 chairs. This is the commutative property of multiplication.

questions.question: Use the distributive property to work out 23 times 25.
questions.expected_answer: 23 times 25 is 20 times 25 plus 3 times 25, which is 500 plus 75, which is 575.

questions.question: Explain the difference between 575 plus 0, 575 times 1 and 575 times 0.
questions.expected_answer: Adding 0 changes nothing, so 575 plus 0 is 575. Multiplying by 1 changes nothing, so 575 times 1 is 575. Multiplying by 0 means zero groups of 575, so 575 times 0 is 0.
